The structure of Mg12Cu2 (reduced formula Mg6Cu) adopts the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows both Cu and Mg centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Cu is surrounded by 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg has 4 Cu and 8 Mg neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.9546–3.1979 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate Mg–Mg and Cu–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, and Mg–Mg pairs also share corners.
